hypotheses.justification: Follows from the other hypotheses. `RiemannGenusReachedAt γ D₀` has the field `finite : FiniteDimensional K (LSpace D₀)`. The library's proof of `finiteDimensional_lSpace` (which assumes LSpace 0 is finite) works the same way with D₀ in place of 0. For any D, set D' = D ⊔ D₀ ≥ D₀. `module_finite_adeleBdd_quotient` needs only [IsCurveOver K F] and D₀ ≤ D'; it gives Module.Finite K (adeleBdd D' ⧸ adeleBdd D₀). `lSpaceQuotientToAdeleBddQuotient_injective` has no hypotheses; it embeds LSpace D' ⧸ LSpace D₀ into that quotient, so that quotient is finite (Module.Finite.of_injective). Together with h.finite, Module.Finite.of_submodule_quotient makes LSpace D' finite. LSpace D ≤ LSpace D' (lSpace_mono), so LSpace D is finite too. With D = 0 this recovers the instance, and the existing proof (indexOfSpecialty_eq_zero_of_genusReached) then applies. It can be removed on its own or together with the Nonempty instance.

Split into two cases. If Place K F is nonempty, use the existing proof with that instance. If Place K F is empty, the type Place K F → F has exactly one element (Pi.uniqueOfIsEmpty). Then the submodule adeleSpace K F and its quotient by adeleBddPrincipal K F D₀ have at most one element. So indexOfSpecialty D₀, defined as the finrank of that quotient, is 0 by Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton, and the goal (indexOfSpecialty D₀ : ℤ) = 0 holds. It can be removed on its own or together with the FiniteDimensional hypothesis.
